document.title: Skill: a title that counts its fixes names one story per fix
document.summary: The Parts rule makes each item under a shared motive its own story.
document.why: [PR #199](source:s1) says vitadeck-150 put four independent fixes in one part because the title says "fix four repo traps".

sources.label: PR #199
sources.title: Skill: a title that counts its fixes names one story per fix
sources.gist: vitadeck-150 eval failed on a bundled repo-traps part.

groups.title: Shared motive splits into stories
groups.summary: The shared-motive bullet under Parts adds a title that counts its fixes, and makes each item that could be its own PR its own story.

attention.note: The old text said the work "can still be several stories"; the new text says each such item "is its own story". This beats a bundling title, but a cleanup sweep of small unrelated items can now split into more parts. The bullet about agent-doc notes still keeps those as one story.

commits.body:
vitadeck-150 put four independent fixes in one part because the PR title says "fix four repo traps". Each item under a shared motive that could have been its own PR is now its own story.
